description: This PHP class defines the ProjectActivityReportController within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to interact with project services. The class's main function preRender sets up a Vue component with props based on HTTP request query parameters, mainly related to project activity reporting, including date ranges, project details, and time sheet inclusion options.
